prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: high-resolution transparent 2D skeletal animation rig sprite atlas for a fitness app. The images are references only: first image defines the desired matte PEARL GRAY athletic mannequin and teal shorts style, second defines seated dumbbell shoulder press and bench.
Create ONE NEW atlas, 2048x2048, exactly FOUR equal square tiles in 2x2 layout. Real transparent background, no grid lines, NO labels/text, NO shadows outside parts. All parts same mannequin skin material and matching orthographic FRONT view lighting, NOT flesh-colored human, no gore, only smooth toy-like rig components.
TOP LEFT TILE: Full seated gray mannequin central body on simple dark bench with upright narrow backrest, teal shorts, gray shoes, planted feet. Head, neck, torso, pelvis, thighs, shins, shoes, bench only. BOTH ARMS COMPLETELY ABSENT, replaced by smooth rounded shoulder joint caps: this is an animation assembly component, no wounds. Body fits fully in tile with 12% clear margin above, below, sides, shoulders clean and symmetric. Exact straight-on front view, neutral face, athletic but not bulky.
TOP RIGHT TILE: one isolated UPPER ARM component of this SAME mannequin, shoulder to elbow only, lying HORIZONTALLY from rounded shoulder on LEFT to rounded elbow on RIGHT. Sculpted deltoid, bicep and tricep, straight relaxed upper arm. BOTH ENDS are fully rounded overlappable joint caps without flat sliced ends. NO forearm, no hand, no torso, no equipment. Component centered with ample empty margin. Width ~55% of tile, thickness anatomically proportionate 15%.
BOTTOM LEFT TILE: one isolated FOREARM+HAND+DUMBBELL component of SAME mannequin: elbow rounded cap at BOTTOM, forearm VERTICAL upward, straight neutral wrist, closed overhand hand grips horizontal small black dumbbell at TOP. Complete realistic thumb and fingers wrapped around handle, two intact round end weights. Only elbow through hand and attached dumbbell, no upper arm/torso. Rounded elbow lower cap for overlap; forearm muscular but anatomically proportionate, component height ~60% tile. Clean sharp silhouette no transparency inside weights. Weight size appropriate for exercise guide.
BOTTOM RIGHT TILE: exactly mirrored copy of bottom left component, for opposite arm, identical scale/material/weight dimensions.
Essential: these are separated reusable animation components, NOT four separate people or four keyframe poses. One central body without arms, one upper arm, two forearm-hand-dumbbell assemblies. Smooth rounded joint ends overlap cleanly during rotation. No motion blur, no doubled limbs, no gradients behind subjects. Consistent gray skin and teal shorts from style reference.
